arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tests/t_expr.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from harness import *
failures=[]
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        failures.append(name); print('FAIL',name); print('  got ',json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True)[:300]); print('  want',json.dumps(want,sort_keys=True)[:300])
    else: print('ok  ',name)
def base(**kw):
    doc={"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
    doc.update(kw); return doc
EXPECT={"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}
def sent_of(doc): return run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]['sent']

tok = rand_token('s','case/0/frame/0/data',0)
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"x<<random_string>>y","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
check('random frame data', sent_of(doc), fp(action(0,0,'D',b'x'+tok.encode()+b'y',True)))

tok0 = rand_token('s','case/0/frame/0/h/0/n',0); tok1 = rand_token('s','case/0/frame/0/h/0/v',0)
tok2 = rand_token('s','case/0/frame/0/h/0/n',1)
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[["<<random_string>><<random_string>>","<<random_string>>"]]}],"expect":EXPECT}])
check('random header coords', sent_of(doc), fp(action(0,0,'H',[(tok0+tok2, tok1)],False)))

etok = rand_token('s','event/0/data',0); ctok = rand_token('s','channel/0/part/1/data',0)
prefix = b'GET /p0 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n'
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"d","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}],
           events=[{"at":1,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":"<<random_string>>","end":True}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":"a","data":"GET /p0 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n"},
                                          {"case":"a","data":"<<random_string>>: v\r\n\r\n"}]}])
r = run(json.dumps(doc))
check('random event coord', r['cases'][0]['received'], fp(action(1,0,'d',etok.encode(),True)))
check('random channel coord', r['channels'][0]['bytes'], fp(prefix+ctok.encode()+b': v\r\n\r\n'))
check('random channel committed', r['channels'][0]['committed'], [0,1])
check('random channel owners', r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['owners'], [['a',len(prefix)+len(ctok)+7]])

doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"a{{b'zz'}}c","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
check('embedded markers literal', sent_of(doc), fp(action(0,0,'D',b"a{{b'zz'}}c",True)))

doc = base(definitions=[["p","b'abc'"],["q","p+p"],["r","q[1:5]"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{ r + p[0:1] }}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
check('expression template', sent_of(doc), fp(action(0,0,'D',b'bcab'+b'a',True)))

doc = base(definitions=[["u","'\u00e9\u00e9'"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{ u[1:3] }}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
check('utf8 slice', sent_of(doc), fp(action(0,0,'D',b'\xa9\xc3',True)))

doc = base(definitions=[["z","b''"],["w","(b'ab')*0"],["v","3*b'xy'"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{ v + w + z + b'!' }}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
check('repeat forms', sent_of(doc), fp(action(0,0,'D',b'xyxyxy!',True)))

bad_exprs = ["b'a'+1","1+1","b'a'*b'b'","-b'a'","b'a'[-1:]","b'a'[::1]","b'a'[0:1:1]","unknown_name",
             "len(b'a')","b'a'.upper()","[b'a']","b'{'a'\"}","b'a' if True else b'b'","lambda: b'a'",
             "b'a' * -1","b'a'[2:1]","b'a'[0:9]","f'b{x}'","b'%s'%1","{'a':1}","(1,2)","True","None",
             "b'a';b'b'","import os","b'a' @ b'b'","b'a'/2","2*3","b'a'+ 1.5","b'a'*2**3","b'a'[None:]",
             "'\\ud800'"]
for expr in bad_exprs:
    doc = base(definitions=[["d",expr]],
               cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{d}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
    check('bad expr '+repr(expr), run(json.dumps(doc)), {"error":"input"})
doc = base(definitions=[["d","b'a'*2*3"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{d}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
check('chained repeat', sent_of(doc), fp(action(0,0,'D',b'a'*6,True)))
for expr in ["later","7"]:
    doc = base(definitions=[["d",expr],["later","b'x'"]],
               cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{d}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
    check('bad def '+expr, run(json.dumps(doc)), {"error":"input"})
for name in ["class","2x","_x","x"*33,"a-b","None"]:
    doc = base(definitions=[[name,"b'x'"]],
               cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{"+name+"}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
    check('bad def name '+name, run(json.dumps(doc)), {"error":"input"})
doc = base(definitions=[["d","b'x'"+"+b'x'"*120]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{d}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
check('long expr ok', sent_of(doc), fp(action(0,0,'D',b'x'*121,True)))
doc = base(definitions=[["d","b'x'"+"+b'x'"*129]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{d}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
check('long expr rejected', run(json.dumps(doc)), {"error":"input"})
doc = base(definitions=[["d","b'x'*1301"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{d}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
check('repeat long ok', sent_of(doc), fp(action(0,0,'D',b'x'*1301,True)))
doc = base(definitions=[["d","b'x'*2   "]])
check('trailing ws ok', run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'], [])
doc = base(definitions=[["d","b'x'*2"+" "*(8192-6)]])
check('source limit ok', run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'], [])
doc = base(definitions=[["d","b'x'*2"+" "*(8193-6)]])
check('source limit rejected', run(json.dumps(doc)), {"error":"input"})
doc = base(definitions=[["d","b'x'"+"[0:1]"*129]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{d}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
check('deep slice rejected', run(json.dumps(doc)), {"error":"input"})
doc = base(definitions=[["d","b'x'"+"[0:1]"*127]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{d}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
check('deep slice accepted', sent_of(doc), fp(action(0,0,'D',b'x',True)))
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"q"*65537,"End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
check('template too long', run(json.dumps(doc)), {"error":"input"})
doc = base(definitions=[["d","b'x'*9223372036854775807"]])
check('huge repeat ok length', run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'], [])
doc = base(definitions=[["d","b'x'*9223372036854775808"]])
check('huge repeat overflow', run(json.dumps(doc)), {"error":"input"})
doc = base(definitions=[["d","{{unterminated"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"x","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
check('definition not template', run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'], [])
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
check('empty expression template', run(json.dumps(doc)), {"error":"input"})
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{b'x'}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
check('no space expression', sent_of(doc), fp(action(0,0,'D',b'x',True)))
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{ b'x' }}extra","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
check('markers not at both ends', sent_of(doc), fp(action(0,0,'D',b"{{ b'x' }}extra",True)))
print('FAILURES:', len(failures))
PYEOF
cd /workspace/project && python3 /workspace/tests/t_expr.py 2>&1 | grep -vE "^ok " | head -20
